title: Schedule profiling load soak and resource validation
goal: Add bounded expensive performance validation for CPU memory allocation throughput saturation and soak behavior, scheduled only by risk/change triggers or explicit on-demand requests.
invariants: performance claims require representative measured evidence
no runtime target is fabricated when no product-runtime boundary exists
benchmark noise cannot silently relax an explicit budget
expensive performance work is triggered proportionally rather than on every trivial change
security_properties: benchmark inputs and result files are untrusted data, never executable configuration
performance tooling remains development-only unless separately approved
resource tests use explicit bounded time and memory limits
acceptance_tests: tests prove stage selection and timeout/resource caps
workflow wiring remains pinned and bounded

performance_budget.rationale: this layer governs performance measurement overhead as well as product targets
metrics: deep tests never run on unrelated PR changes

rollback.strategy: revert the E6 unit while retaining verified E0-E5 controls

definition_of_done: profiles are evidence artifacts not runtime dependencies
no runtime target yields deferred/not-applicable evidence
